notes.title: update notes 03-01-2015
notes.notes:
- The guards are more responsive and are more vicious in tracking you down.

- Small fixes in the environment where it could cause some problems for some players.

- The player now has a first person mode ;)

- The camera controls are also improved.

- There is now a tutorial in place of the notes.

- We also improved the performance of most of the levels, you should have more fps now.

notes.title: We hear you!
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

We have noticed the bugs in the video of jim sterling and the other video's. First we want to apologize for the state of our release. Because we are a small indie studio, we don't really have a lot of quality assurance. The "slender bug" Jim Sterling found was never discovered in our testing. 
We are working hard to get the bugs fixed, especially the camera controls, and improve on the feedback you gave.

We made some mistakes in our rush to reach the deadline, that we can admit. However we also want to point out that we are a starting indie studio with just 6 guys working hard on this game. The animations are what they are, we never showed  false images in our trailers and screenshots or promised things not in the game already. 

Soon there will be a patch with quite a bit of rebalancing in the gameplay and the guards will be more responsive.

Again I apologize to our buyers and Valve, and wish everybody a nice Christmas and a Happy New Year.

Cheers,
Happylifes

notes.title: Launch Announcements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

we have decided to keep the most of the translations behind because of our time restraint going for our release.
All the translations and the linux and mac os x support will be added soon. 


Translations added will be:
- Dutch
- Russian
- German
- French
- Portuguese
- Polish
- Turkish


We want to thank you all for your patience and enjoy!
